_comment: Generated by scripts/export_tools.py. Do not edit. The coach's tool surface, shared by the Python and Android apps.

tools.name: get_daily_metrics
tools.description: Daily wellness telemetry from the watch: steps, sleep_minutes, resting_hr, hrv_ms, active_minutes, body_weight_kg. Use for questions about sleep, recovery, step load, or bodyweight trends.

tools.name: get_training_load
tools.description: Daily training load with acute (7d) and chronic (28d) averages and their ratio (ACWR). Use for readiness, overreaching, tapering, and 'am I doing too much' questions.

tools.name: get_exercise_history
tools.description: Per-session history for one lift: best estimated 1RM, top weight, volume and working sets by date. Use for strength progression questions.

tools.name: get_volume_summary
tools.description: Aggregated training volume and working sets over a range, grouped by muscle, exercise, week or day. Use for balance, weak-point and weekly-tonnage questions.

tools.name: get_recent_activities
tools.description: Cardio activities from Strava with distance, moving time, heart rate and computed pace in min/km. Use for running, cycling and pacing questions.

tools.name: get_workout
tools.description: Every set performed on one date, with volume and estimated 1RM.

tools.name: list_exercises
tools.description: The exercise catalogue, optionally filtered. Use to resolve a name before logging a set, or to check what the athlete actually trains.

tools.name: log_set
tools.description: Record one completed set. Creates the day's workout and the exercise if they do not exist. Weight is kilograms. Only call this when the athlete states they actually performed the set.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save a durable fact about the athlete that should inform future coaching: an injury, a goal, a schedule constraint, a training block, or a preference. These are loaded into every future conversation.
